title: A functor isomorphic, through covering-compatible equivalences, to a morphism of sites is one
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (Stacks sites: categories with sets of covering families). Let $p:\mathcal A\to\mathcal C$ and $q:\mathcal B\to\mathcal D$ be equivalences of categories such that a family $\{X_a\to X\}_{a\in A}$ of morphisms of $\mathcal A$ with common target is a covering of $\mathcal A$ if and only if $\{p(X_a)\to p(X)\}_{a\in A}$ is a covering of $\mathcal C$, and likewise for $q$ (a family of $\mathcal B$ is a covering iff its image under $q$ is a covering of $\mathcal D$). Let $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a continuous functor which defines a morphism of sites $\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ (i.e. $u_s$ on sheaves of sets is exact) [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](3), and let $u':\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a functor together with a natural isomorphism $q\circ u'\cong u\circ p$. Then $u'$ is continuous (Sites, Definition 00WV: it maps coverings to coverings, and for a covering $\{X_a\to X\}$ and a morphism $T\to X$ of $\mathcal A$ the canonical morphisms $u'(T\times_XX_a)\to u'(T)\times_{u'(X)}u'(X_a)$ are isomorphisms) and defines a morphism of sites $\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ ($u'_s$ on sheaves of sets is exact). (Sketch, for the queue: an equivalence preserves and reflects fibre products and isomorphisms, and a covering family stays one after composing with isomorphisms (axioms (i), (ii) of 00VH), which gives continuity; $p$ and a quasi-inverse are continuous, so $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G\circ p$ is an equivalence $\Sh(\mathcal C)\to\Sh(\mathcal A)$, likewise for $q$; then $u'^s\circ q^s\cong p^s\circ u^s$, so by uniqueness of left adjoints $u'_s$ is isomorphic to the composite of $u_s$ with equivalences, hence exact.)
